Class PlayerOfferPhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.phase.PlayerOfferPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhase
public class PlayerOfferPhase extends Object implements GamePhase
Represents the main gameplay phase where players acquire cards from the board.

This phase is highly stateful, tracking exactly whose turn it is, how many cards they have picked from each row (upper or lower), and whether any special building effects (like the "Extra Pick" ability) are currently altering the standard flow.

  • Method Details

    • setup

      public Optional<GameDelta> setup(Game game)
      Executes preliminary phase setup, specifically handling the "A" track slot bonus.

      If the first player placed their totem on the "A" slot, they immediately receive food, return their totem, and their turn ends before any card picking begins.

      Parameters:
      game - the current game instance
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the resulting network delta, if the bonus was triggered

    • takeCard

      public List<GameDelta> takeCard(Game game, Player player, String cardId)
      Handles the core logic of a player attempting to take a card from the board.

      This method orchestrates the validation of the turn, enforces the drawing limits dictated by the player's position on the offer track, triggers card abilities via the Notificator Center, and determines whether the turn or the entire phase should advance. Moreover, handles extra pick building logic and skip pick logic.

      Specified by:
      takeCard in interface GamePhase
      Parameters:
      game - the main game instance
      player - the player attempting the action
      cardId - the unique identifier of the target card, or "skip" if the player chooses to pass
      Returns:
      a list of network deltas representing the state changes caused by the action
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if it is not the player's turn or if the pick violates the rules
